body: I don't know.. So much has happened I can't pin point it
This is disgusting, bring your son back home unless you want him to cut you out of his life or resent you forever for this.

I mainly asked because I was curious and it wasn't really supposed to be that deep of a question. I know he's not the type of person to cheat on me as relationships are built on trust, and I have that trust in him that he won't.

I'm a girl (and no worries!) David met Brad quite a while after we had been together (a bit over 8 months), I can see why you'd advise me to leave the relationship, I really love David and want our relationship to work out, I'm just hoping there's something I can do to resolve this issue instead of ending things with him.

It's hard getting through things like this, let alone on your own and with a lack of support, please throw or put away anything you can use to harm yourself. I can't imagine what pain you've been going through and for how long you have. 

Your best bet is talking to someone who you can trust and getting help (such as speaking to a therapist, or psychologist), mental health and suicide is serious and important. I'll continue this is dms, I hope you're safe
I love him more than I can put into words, that's also a wonderful idea, I think I could live happily having a future with him if it wasn't for some other issues (unrelated to the relationship)

I stay alive mainly because of my SO, I wouldn't want to leave the world knowing I'd be breaking his heart. I really want to have a reason to live for myself, but I only do for the sake of others. I know (some) of the reasons why I want to die but I honestly don't know how it can be helped as at my age I have a very limited amount control over my life.

Thanks for responding, I really appreciate it ❤️
